app_summary: An online shop selling astronomy products, based on the OpenTelemetry Demo. It is built with polyglot microservices (Go, Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Rust, ...) communicating via gRPC and HTTP behind an Envoy frontend-proxy, with Kafka for asynchronous order processing and Valkey as cart store. Supported Operations: View product catalog, Receive product recommendations and ads, Add item to cart, Checkout with selected items, Currency conversion, Process payment, Generate shipping quotes, Send order confirmation emails

rca_analyses_list.diagnosis: Envoy (frontend-proxy) upstream timeout: the frontend-proxy Envoy proxy (pod frontend-proxy-55b6b6c7d9-c2n6p) canceled an in-flight /api/checkout request and returned HTTP 504 (response_flags=UT). The trace shows the checkout flow (prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart in pod checkout-6598d86d4b-5rd2f) took ~19.9s, exceeding the proxy timeout (~15s), so Envoy timed out the upstream and returned 504.

message_history.content: Hypothesis 1: There may be failing or CrashLoopBackOff pods in the astronomy-shop namespace; list all pods to find unhealthy ones. I'll fetch pods in the astronomy-shop namespace.
Hypothesis 2: The frontend-proxy is producing error traces indicating request failures; fetch traces for frontend-proxy filtered to only error traces.

Hypothesis 3: The detailed trace for traceID b1ab89... will contain spans with errors or long durations revealing the failing component (e.g., timeout or repeated retries). I'll retrieve the full trace.

args.root_cause: Envoy (frontend-proxy) upstream timeout: the frontend-proxy Envoy proxy (pod frontend-proxy-55b6b6c7d9-c2n6p) canceled an in-flight /api/checkout request and returned HTTP 504 (response_flags=UT). The trace shows the checkout flow (prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart in pod checkout-6598d86d4b-5rd2f) took ~19.9s, exceeding the proxy timeout (~15s), so Envoy timed out the upstream and returned 504.
args.evidence_summary:
Trace b1ab89fbd1afe5d8e9c5fe392ca5e95b (frontend-proxy entry) contains: 
- Envoy client/server spans (spanID 0f4190aae3d33eeb and 14bf634a5403fbc4) with tags: http.status_code=504, response_flags=UT, error=true, canceled=true and very large durations (~15s), indicating an upstream timeout/cancel by Envoy.
- The frontend server span for /api/checkout (fe9235a0991cd8dd) shows the request was active ~15s.
- The checkout internal span prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart has duration ~19903ms (~19.9s), and related checkout downstream calls (currency, payment, shipping) are present in the same trace, showing the checkout processing exceeded the proxy timeout.
- Redis/Valkey and product-catalog DB calls in the trace succeeded but are part of a long request path. 
These combined show Envoy timed out the upstream because checkout took longer than Envoy’s timeout window (UT).
args.investigation_summary: 1) Listed pods in astronomy-shop to confirm services are running. 2) Queried frontend-proxy error traces and found multiple error traces with ~15s latencies. 3) Retrieved full trace b1ab89f... and inspected spans: Envoy spans report response_flags=UT and HTTP 504, while checkout’s prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart span took ~19.9s. Conclusion: Envoy timed out the upstream request because checkout processing exceeded the proxy timeout.

stats.experiment_name: M - ReAct Baseline B14 - Astronomy Shop - Cart service failure (261013_AblationReact)

evaluation.rca_motivation: The incident is about the cart service failing EmptyCart operations due to inability to access its Valkey cart storage, breaking checkout. The agent instead attributes the issue to an Envoy frontend-proxy timeout on checkout taking too long, focusing on a different component and symptom, so the analysis does not match the actual root cause at all.
